Dirty COW race

O_RDONLY + read-only MAP_PRIVATE
Writer: pwrite to /proc/self/mem
Discard: MADV_DONTNEED
Vulnerable kernel → file changes
pwrite uses a virtual process address. The race is inside kernel COW/page handling.
